title: MZ Yanfly's Scale Sprite Plugin but for MZ

posts.author: Lordbagra
posts.body: I am looking for a plugin or notetag from an existing plugin that allows me to scale enemy sprites used in RPG Maker MZ, similarly to Yanfly's <Scale Sprite: x%> notetag with their Animated SV Enemies Plugin. I greatly appreciate any help.

posts.author: Timeline_man
posts.body:
YEP_Scalesprites is listed as working with Project FOSSIL, Have you tried that?
(Project FOSSIL)
